problems.deptName: Public Works Department (PWD), Govt of Maharashtra
problems.title: AI-Powered Computer Vision for Automated Pothole & Road Quality Indexing
problems.description: Development of an edge-computing vehicular camera system that automatically maps, classifies, and estimates asphalt deterioration and potholes along state highways in real-time with GPS coordinates.
problems.eligibilityCriteria: DPIIT recognized startups with proven computer vision models OR joint consortium with OEM dashcam/sensor manufacturers.
problems.videoTitle: PWD Technical Explainer: Automated Highway Quality Audit

targetBeneficiaries.title: Highway Commuters & Drivers
targetBeneficiaries.desc: Prevents vehicular damage and fatal accidents.

problems.whyNeeded: Manual road quality audits cover less than 12% of Maharashtra road network per year.
problems.urgencyReason: Monsoon season deterioration requires automated continuous telemetry.

publicImpactMetrics.label: Audit Speedup
publicImpactMetrics.subtext: Continuous coverage vs manual walking surveys

problems.deptName: Department of Agriculture & Farmer Welfare, Maharashtra
problems.title: Precision Micro-Drone Payload for Targeted Bio-Pesticide Spraying in Vidarbha
problems.description: Autonomous micro-UAV system with multispectral pest detection to perform hyper-localized bio-pesticide misting on cotton and soybean crops.
problems.eligibilityCriteria: DGCA type certified UAV frames OR joint venture with licensed drone manufacturer.
problems.videoTitle: Agri Dept Challenge: Targeted Bio-Pesticide Payload
problems.whyNeeded: Traditional backpack spraying exposes over 4,00,000 smallholder farmers to chemical toxicity.
problems.urgencyReason: Seasonal Pink Bollworm infestations require precision localized misting.
